author: Rob Foster (iNaturalist rob21)
notes: BEST. Wild wolf, Thunder Bay ON, 2021-05-21. True profile, camera level, standing square, head forward (mouth slightly open), all four paws on plain asphalt. Max size available from iNat open data is 2048 px. Credit: (c) Rob Foster, CC BY.

author: J. G. Keulemans (del. et lith.) in St G. Mivart 1890 Dogs Jackals Wolves and Foxes
notes: Hand-coloured lithograph 'The Common Wolf, Canis lupus'. True side, standing square, full brush and neck ruff drawn. Mountain backdrop is pale, ground is light: easy cut-out. Whole page kept unmodified (IA leaf n57). IA marks NOT_IN_COPYRIGHT. Drawn from life but an artist's rendering (body a little jackal-lean).

author: Mila C. (iNaturalist mbwildlife)
notes: Captive wolf, Indiana, 2021-12-31. True side body, standing square, heavy winter coat and ruff. Head turned ~30 deg toward camera. Chain-link fence behind (not in front); dry leaves around paws. Same observation has more frames (174318793-174319100).

author: J. G. Keulemans in Mivart 1890
notes: 'The American Wolf, Canis lupus var. occidentalis'. Faces right, standing, near-square, full brush. Trees behind and tufts by the forefeet. Whole page kept (IA leaf n73).

author: Drew Avery
notes: Very clean true profile, square stance, head forward, plain dirt ground; wire fence behind. LOW RES: only the 1024 px Flickr size could be fetched (Flickr rate-limited this session); the original on Flickr is larger, fetch by hand.

author: Rob Foster
notes: Same wolf and moment as rank 1, head turned to camera. Use only if rank 1 fails; good for checking the body.

author: Nigel Voaden (iNaturalist terathopius)
notes: Wild wolf, Denali AK, 2015. True profile, head forward, standing; green grass hides the paws (slight occlusion at the feet). Bluish light.

author: J. G. Keulemans in Mivart 1890
notes: 'The Indian Wolf'. Clean right-facing profile, legs well separated. Smaller, short-coated subspecies: a useful lean bound vs the northern wolves. Grass tufts near hind paw.

author: J. G. Keulemans in Mivart 1890
notes: 'The Wolf (black variety)'. Left-facing standing profile; dark animal on light ground: very easy silhouette; legs slightly overlapping.

author: Sean Frey (iNaturalist georectified)
notes: Wild wolf, Riding Mountain NP MB, 2008. True profile walking, head forward, all four feet down on short grass. Shedding coat (ragged).

author: Claude Kolwelter
notes: Captive, Saarland DE, 2025. Walking profile on lawn; plain green background.

author: shankar s.
notes: Walking true profile; small desert subspecies. LOW RES (Flickr large only; original not fetched because of rate limiting).

author: Yellowstone National Park (NPS)
licence: public domain (US government work; Flickr Public Domain Mark)
notes: Wild wolf on road near Artist Paint Pots. Standing square, head turned to camera. LOW RES copy; original on Flickr is larger (fetch by hand).

author: Marcus de Bye after Paulus Potter (etching 1657-c.1677)
notes: 'Staande wolf, en profil' but actually a three-quarter view from in front: NOT a true profile. Kept only as a shaggy-coat reference.

author: Rolf Lawrenz
notes: BEST DINGO. Wild, K'gari (Fraser Island) beach, 2026-05-22. True profile, camera level, head forward, plain flat sand: ideal cut-out. Walking (one forefoot lifted); tail carried high in a loose curve (alert), not hanging.

author: Paul Coddington
notes: Wild, Lindon SA, 2024-06-07. Big, sharp, true profile, head forward, mouth open; tail brush slightly raised. Low scrub around the hind feet.

author: MJDapifer
notes: Wild, Petermann NT, 2011. Standing nearly square on plain red sand; head forward, slightly toward camera. Small in frame.

author: J. G. Keulemans in Mivart 1890
notes: 'The Dingo, Canis dingo'. Standing profile facing left, ruff and brush drawn; a bone near the hind feet. Whole page kept (IA leaf n279).

author: Bruce Cathie
notes: Wild, Fraser Island 2019. Near-profile walking on sand, head forward; small plants near feet; strong shadows.

author: Rolf Lawrenz
notes: Same dingo as rank 1, another frame; plain sand.

author: John Barkla
notes: Wild, Queensland beach, 2017. Body in profile, head turned to camera, dim light.

author: SteveMcD
notes: The ONLY genuinely labelled Carolina Dog photo found under an allowed licence. Three-quarter front view (not a true profile), ball in mouth, typical fishhook tail held up, pale ginger. LOW RES: Flickr original not fetched (429).

author: Linda Lötjönen
notes: PROXY, not a Carolina Dog: free-ranging village dog, Ngong, Kenya, 2012. Same landrace build (prick ears, lean, medium). Body in true profile standing square on plain dirt; head turned to camera.

author: 祐 (iNaturalist user)
notes: PROXY: free-ranging pariah-type dog, Yunlin, Taiwan, 2026. Standing square on plain pavement, prick ears, lean legs; three-quarter front view, not a true profile.

author: olmagon
notes: PROXY: ginger free-ranging dog, Peng Chau HK, 2016. Ginger coat and curled-over tail like the Carolina Dog; true profile, but head down sniffing and a metal railing crosses in front of the neck (heavy occlusion).

author: Pavel Smirnov
notes: PROXY: group of ginger pariah dogs, Sanya, China, 2026. Left dog is in near-profile with a sickle tail up, but the dogs overlap. Colour and tail reference only.
